description: Election Commission - Mr. S. U. Bopitiya member of the Balangoda P/S has Vacated his Office Under 10A (i)(a) of LAEO - Mr. P. L. A. L. Udayaruwan Cooray, member of the Imbulpe P/S has Vacated his Office Under 10A(i)(a) of LAEO
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices from a Returning Officer declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local authorities) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and matters related to local government elections, specifically addressing vacancies in elected positions, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) covering electoral matters including declarations related to elected officials.
